title: Shopify App Redesign
meta: A cleaner admin interface for your Shopify app built with Polaris, keeping your merchants and data. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Shopify app redesign that merchants find easy to use
overview: Merchants judge an app by its admin screens. We review how people move through yours, then redesign the key pages with Polaris so they feel native inside Shopify. That covers layout, empty states, tables, forms and error messages. We rebuild the screens in code, keep your data and features as they are, and test on desktop and the Shopify mobile app.

faq: Do my app's features have to change?
No. A redesign changes how screens look and flow, not what the app does. Your logic, data and settings stay as they are, so merchants find everything where they expect it.
Will the design follow Shopify's guidelines?
Yes. We build with Polaris, Shopify's own component library, so your app feels like part of the admin and stays easy to keep updated as Polaris evolves.
Will merchants need to do anything after the update?
No. The new screens appear when they next open the app. We write a short in-app note or changelog text if you want to tell them about the change.
Do you design in Figma before building?
Yes, for the first screens. You approve those mockups, then we build the rest in the same style. A full Figma file of every page is included in the Premium package.
